market.question: Will the highest temperature in Lagos be 32°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Lagos, Nigeria forecast for May 8 ~29°C (Wunderground/AccuWeather). Bucket '32°C' would require a 3°C overshoot vs forecast. May Lagos averages 29-31°C high. Probability of high landing in 32°C bucket is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tropical microclimate variability; Murtala Muhammad airport station vs central readings.
